entries.name: summarize-pro

evidence.tracer: citecheck maps each output sentence to source tokens

entries.differentiator_zh: 每条数字/日期可回溯；结论按 已定/暂定/提案/条件 分级；待办按 明确接活/被点名未确认/仅表意向 分级
entries.differentiator_en: Every figure traced to source; decisions graded firm/provisional/proposal/conditional; commitments graded committed/named_unconfirmed/intent_only

entries.name: debug-pro
entries.differentiator_zh: 把「我复现了」变成证据表：异常类型/末栈帧/退出码/HTTP 状态/时间戳一次给全
entries.differentiator_en: Turns 'I reproduced it' into an evidence table: exception type, last frame, exit code, HTTP status, timestamp

entries.name: wechat-viral-topic

evidence.tracer: redline names the exact sentence that trips each rule

entries.differentiator_zh: 选题按证据强度分级（真信号/弱信号/猜测），合规红线点名到句子
entries.differentiator_en: Topics graded signal / weak signal / guess; red lines point at the offending sentence

entries.name: lgd-skill-review
entries.differentiator_zh: 六维审计引擎本身：扣分必须给证据，输出分数+阻断项+整改顺序，可整改后复评
entries.differentiator_en: The auditor itself: evidence-backed deductions, score + blockers + ordered remediation, re-runnable after fixes
